purpose: Teach: リサイタル/霊感/傍観/重き/ダブリン/打席/スタメン/チューニング

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: リク、ピアノの、本気で、絶対、リサイタル、絶対、お前と、絶対、行きたいよ
lines.en: Riku, I really mean it — I absolutely want to go to your piano recital.
lines.style: Bright and direct, slight lean forward on the commitment. Warm excitement barely contained. Eyes locked. No hesitation on the core truth underneath the enthusiasm.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: うん。お前、本気で、絶対、ちょっと、絶対、霊感、絶対、あるって、絶対、言ってたよな、桜
lines.en: Yeah. And you said before — you know, that you kind of have this sense about people, remember?
lines.style: Slow, thoughtful opening. Gentle recall, like he's testing the connection. Quiet certainty underneath. Not accusatory — curious, almost wondering why she said it.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: いじめを、本気で、絶対、傍観、絶対、する、絶対、ような、絶対、人、絶対、嫌よね、リク
lines.en: I hate people who just stand there and watch bullying happen. You know?
lines.style: Quiet conviction. Direct eye contact. Each phrase lands separately. Soft but unshakeable — like she's telling him something she needs him to know about her.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: 俺、本気で、絶対、友情に、絶対、重き、絶対、を、絶対、置いてるぜ、桜
lines.en: Look, I take friendship seriously. I really do.
lines.style: Steady, almost defensive in its gentleness. A small smile underneath. Not performing — stating something true about himself that matters to him. Slight head tilt toward her.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: 修学旅行で、本気で、絶対、ダブリン、絶対、行きたいよね、リク
lines.en: For the school trip, I really want to go to Dublin with you.
lines.style: Warm and hopeful, building slightly toward the end. Casual phrasing but the eyes say she's already imagining it. Not asking — sharing the thought like it's already real.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: 今日の試合の、本気で、絶対、打席、絶対、俺、絶対、頑張るぜ、桜
lines.en: In today's game, I'm going to really give it everything when I'm at bat.
lines.style: Focused intensity. Quiet determination. Not boasting — making a promise to himself and her both. Slight nod, eyes forward. The settled calm before effort.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: お前、本気で、絶対、今日の試合の、絶対、スタメン、絶対、入れたんでしょ?リク
lines.en: Wait — you actually made the starting lineup for today's game, didn't you?
lines.style: Sudden brightness, almost a gasp-quality on the realization. Pride breaks through the cool exterior. Slight teasing warmth underneath the question — she already knows the answer.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: 吹奏楽部、本気で、絶対、楽器の、絶対、チューニング、絶対、しっかり、絶対、やってるぜ、桜
lines.en: The wind ensemble — we're really taking our instrument tuning seriously. Everything locked in.
lines.style: Quiet pride. Careful, almost ritualistic in tone — like he's describing something sacred to him. Steady. Slight uptick at the end, sharing the satisfaction, not asking for validation.
